definitions: Resembling milk in color, consistency, smell, etc.; consisting of milk.
Of the black in an image, appearing as dark gray rather than black.

blocks.text: Milky is an Italian dance music production group consisting of producers Giordano Trivellato and Giuliano Sacchetto, with Italian singer Giuditta Gazza serving as their lead singer on their album Star. They are best known for their 2002 single "Just the Way You Are".
